vb_textbox.text: Concentrate on the written instructions reading them through a few times to make sure you are clear what you need to do. You will only use three keys S K and space and cannot click through quicker as each screen is up for a set amount of time, this game is not speed based. Develop a regular rythym, I was too slow on some because I was thinking too long about which to gnome to choose lost my rythym and missed the baskets. I lost concentration as I was in the kitchen and the cooker alarm went off so would recommend somewhere quiet where you will not be disturbed.I didnt spot a pattern and initially tried to which I think slowed me down and so made errors.At one point I chose the same side repetitively to no apparant detriment. It seems to me to be random but my pattern spotting skills are not strong.I would advise to be rythmic and develop a clicking pattern that suits you to minimise the no score from being too slow and having 'finger trouble' i.e. getting the fingers to press the buttons you want when you want them too!
